notes: A206912_diff: A206912 (n+1) = A206912 n + 1 or + 2 for all n, with A206912 n = n + ncard {k >= 1 : H_k < log(n+1)} (Mathlib harmonic). Key lemma two_consecutive_not_between: log m <= H_k and H_{k+1} < log(m+1) is impossible (1/(k+1) < log(1+1/m) <= 1/m forces m <= k, then H_k >= log(k+1) >= log(m+1)). Ties H_k = log(n+1) not used. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (data agreement checked numerically by certificate/check.py).
